edges: The film 'Lost River' explores the themes of dereliction and hope in the city of Detroit.
Gosling discusses the presence of Lost Rivers in relation to the experiences of people.
Lost Rivers are part of the current issues that Detroit is facing.
Gosling claims that a paradox should exist when discussing Detroit.
The visual content of 'Lost River' revolves around dereliction and plays on the outside world's perception of Detroit.
Aspects of the narrative of 'Lost River' suggest hope and the possibility of reincarnation for Detroit.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Gosling has a longstanding affection for Motor City, having grown up nearby.
